# Preliminary incident assessment
Generated: 2026-10-16T19:40:38.549Z
Incident type: flood | Location: main road | Severity (system assessment): undetermined

## Summary
A report describes rapidly rising floodwater on a main road, presenting potential traffic hazards. However, an accompanying image shows a smoky, dry residential backyard, contradicting the report of road flooding.

## 1. What was reported
- Flooding on the main road (reported)
- Water is rising quickly (reported)

## 2. What was observed in the image
- Hazy sky with a dull orange sun indicating heavy smoke or haze (confidence: high, source: image)
- Dense trees and bushes surrounding a yard area (confidence: high, source: image)
- Wooden utility pole and power lines on the left side (confidence: high, source: image)
- Backyard items including a metal shed, blue barrel, wooden fence, stacked firewood, and potted plants (confidence: high, source: image)
- Inconsistency with report: Report mentions flooding on the main road with rising water, but the image shows a dry yard area with no visible road or standing water.

## 3. Relevant information from the knowledge base
Coverage: partial
- Driving through floodwater: no depth is safe; do not drive or walk through floodwater, and postpone trips when roads are flooded or blocked. (FL-14, en/flood_kb.md::section::7)
- Never walk, swim or drive through floodwater; even 6 in (15 cm) of fast‑moving water can knock you over, and 12 in (30 cm) can carry a vehicle away. (FL-04, en/flood_kb.md::section::4)
- Do not travel through water; move to an upper floor and follow the instructions of rescuers and the town hall. (FL-12, en/flood_kb.md::section::6)
- Restez informé et écoutez les consignes des secours et de la mairie. (FL-08, fr/flood_kb.md::section::4)
- Ne prenez pas la voiture pendant une inondation; reportez tous vos déplacements, à pied ou en voiture. Ne descendez pas dans les sous‑sols ni dans les parkings souterrains. (FL-05, fr/flood_kb.md::section::1)
No guidance available in the knowledge base for this point. Follow the instructions of the authorities and emergency services.

## 4. System assessment
Severity: undetermined
Basis:
- Report states flooding on the main road with rising water and moderate initial severity. (report)
- Image shows a residential backyard under a smoky, hazy sky with no visible water or road. (image)
Main risks:
- Potential flood‑related traffic hazards and road blockage. (report)
- Reduced visibility and possible fire or smoke hazard in the residential area shown in the image. (image)
Possibly affected:
- Main road users (vehicles, pedestrians) (report)
- Nearby residential properties and residents (report)
- Residents in the backyard area depicted in the image (image)
Conflicts:
- Report mentions flooding on the main road with rising water, but the image depicts a dry backyard with no visible water or road.

## 5. Missing information and uncertainties
Uncertainties:
- Image analysis could not determine water depth, cause of smoke/haze, or exact location.
- Conflict between report and image creates uncertainty about the actual presence of flooding at the reported site.
- No information on number of people affected or road closure status.
Information needed:
- Water depth at the reported flood site
- Exact stretch of road affected by flooding
- Number of people affected or trapped
- Road closure status
- Impact on nearby properties
- Emergency response contact details
- Confirmation of flooding presence at the location described in the report
- Cause of the smoke/haze observed in the image

## About this report
This report is a decision-support output from an AI prototype. It does not replace emergency services and is not an official emergency decision. The severity scale is a working scale of this prototype.
